meta.title: Analysis inference: data flow in three modes

cards.title: one_shot
items: A single relationship_inference stage receives the full safe context, bounded by the context byte limit. No tools. Validation repair can add attempts. Evidence: context.py:634-645; analysis/service.py:421-444.

cards.title: tool_assisted
items: The same relationship_inference stage starts with a manifest. The agent requests get_agent_context_manifest or get_agent_context_dataset pages from immutable preloaded records; these tools perform no database or external calls. Evidence: authoring/context.py:335-336,452-459,622-633; agents/adapters.py:170-183.

cards.title: detailed_coverage
items: The executor sends bounded object/attribute evidence slices through candidate_finder, relationship_resolver, whole_slice_reconciler, then analysis_reviewer. Each stage uses AgentStageRunner with no tools. A blocker fails validation. Evidence: analysis/service.py:552-980.

cards.title: Shared inputs and result
items: Inputs include selected Objects and Attributes, Model details, applicable Assertions, Profiles and applied Analysis. Provider context excludes physical rows and secrets. Evidence: authoring/context.py:312-333,777-882.

Arrows describe data movement; adapter output is validated inside the stage runner, and the executor hands final changes to WorkflowChangeSetHandoff. Detailed mode validates intermediate stages too. Evidence: authoring/stage_runner.py:50-115; analysis/service.py:445-489.
No effective changes completes the run without a draft. Applying a draft is outside this inference diagram. Evidence: analysis/service.py:459-489; authoring/change_set_handoff.py:449-515.
Sources refer to the current local working tree, including uncommitted edits. Every box maps to repository code or a defined database table.

cards.title: Trace the code: how to use this guide
items: Open the repository in your editor. Use Go to File with each path, then Go to Line with the number after the colon. Follow sections 1–6 in order; section 5 branches by execution mode. Paths are relative to the repository root and line numbers reflect this working tree.

For an already authorized run, use the browser Network panel to follow the create response workflow_run_id into the execute request and later run/event reads. The HTTP request and background worker have separate call stacks. Suggested breakpoints: dialog mutation, backend create/start, worker dispatcher, executor context load, selected mode stage, handoff.
The ten diagram boxes remain the inference data path. This guide adds the frontend entry, HTTP boundary, background worker and UI return without adding diagram nodes.

cards.title: 1. Frontend: open and submit
items: web_app/frontend/src/features/analysis/AnalysisScreen.tsx:172 — Run inference button opens WorkflowRunDialog. At line 253, executeCreated is wired to api.executeAnalysisInferenceRun.

web_app/frontend/src/features/workflows/WorkflowRunDialog.tsx:105 — onSubmit builds selected_object_ids, workflow_execution_mode, expected_model_revision and agent settings. runMutation at line 143 creates the run, receives workflow_run_id, then calls executeCreated. Follow this ID for the rest of the trace.

web_app/frontend/src/features/workflows/api.ts:400 — createWorkflowRun sends POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/models/{modelId}/runs with an Idempotency-Key. executeAnalysisInferenceRun at line 453 sends POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/models/{modelId}/analysis/inference-runs/{workflowRunId}/execute.

cards.title: 2. Backend: create, then start
items: web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/main.py:359 — Registers the inference route; workflow command routes are registered at line 494.
web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/workflows/commands/router.py:26 — create_run authenticates the request and calls service.create_run.
web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/workflows/commands/service.py:96 — create_run checks agent selection and tenant authorization, then calls application.create_workflow_run.
database/13_application_workflow_runs.sql:1091 — application.create_workflow_run is the SQL implementation to inspect for selected scope, revision, run creation and frozen prompt configuration.

web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/analysis/router.py:49 — execute_run authenticates and calls AnalysisInferenceWorkflow.start (analysis/service.py:262), which calls DatabaseAgentWorkflowLifecycle.start (authoring/lifecycle.py:247). The route returns 202 when the run transitions to running.

database/13_application_workflow_runs.sql:2139 — application.start_workflow_run performs the governed start. This HTTP request does not execute the agent; the worker picks up the durable run separately.

cards.title: 3. Worker: cross the asynchronous boundary
items: web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/workflow_worker.py:72 — run_worker_loop calls worker.run_once. Worker dependencies are assembled at line 163. Continue in the worker process, not the HTTP request call stack.
web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/workflows/execution/worker.py:149 — run_once calls claim_next, then the lease runner runs the dispatcher and maintains the claim heartbeat.

web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/workflows/execution/repository.py:56 — claim_next calls application.claim_next_workflow_run; its SQL implementation is database/13_application_workflow_runs.sql:2281.

web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/workflows/execution/dispatcher.py:36 — execute selects analysis_inference when model_workflow is analysis and execution mode is not null; calls execute_started at line 68.

web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/workflows/execution/assembly.py:156 — Wires DatabaseAnalysisInferenceExecutor to the shared context repository, stage runner, validator handoff and lifecycle. Use this file when tracing an injected dependency.

cards.title: 4. Executor: load inputs and choose the mode
items: web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/analysis/service.py:334 — DatabaseAnalysisInferenceExecutor.execute_started checks tenant authorization and the run plan, then loads context. Inspect mode selection at line 375 and branch at line 408.
web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/workflows/authoring/plan.py:253 — PostgresAgentRunPlanRepository.load reconstructs the frozen run plan and selection.

web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/workflows/authoring/context.py:554 — PostgresAgentContextRepository.load reads selected Objects/Attributes and the Model snapshot. _assemble_context at line 777 filters Profiles, Assertions and prior Analysis to the relevant scope.

web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/workflows/authoring/context.py:622 — Mode-specific input: tool_assisted creates the local catalog and embeds its manifest; detailed_coverage leaves embedded_context empty for per-stage batching; one_shot embeds full safe context.

cards.title: 5. Agent calls: follow your selected mode
items: web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/analysis/service.py:421 — one_shot and tool_assisted both call relationship_inference. one_shot supplies context without tools. tool_assisted supplies a manifest and the local catalog.

web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/workflows/authoring/context.py:452 — Tool-assisted page requests are dispatched here: get_agent_context_manifest or get_agent_context_dataset. The catalog serves immutable preloaded records, not live SQL.

web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/analysis/service.py:552 — detailed_coverage enters _execute_detailed: candidate_finder at line 617; relationship_resolver at line 725; whole_slice_reconciler at line 822; analysis_reviewer at line 944. Each has bounded evidence, its own validator and no tools.

web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/workflows/authoring/stage_runner.py:50 — AgentStageRunner.run projects prompt inputs, renders frozen prompts and invokes ValidationRepairRunner. Follow authoring/repair.py:347 for validation/retry behavior.

web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/integrations/agents/adapters.py:185 — OpenAIAgentsSdkAdapter.execute constructs the configured model request. Runner.run at line 234 performs model turns and any allowed local tool calls. Candidate JSON returns to the stage runner for validation.

cards.title: 6. Result: validated draft back to the frontend
items: web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/analysis/candidate.py:76 — AnalysisInferenceCandidateValidator checks candidate structure and scoped relationship semantics. The executor parses validated changes at analysis/service.py:445.

web_app/backend/gds_workbench_api/features/workflows/authoring/change_set_handoff.py:159 — WorkflowChangeSetHandoff.finalize stages and validates changes and completes the run. _handoff_in_transaction at line 449 records validated draft status. No effective changes instead uses the no-op path at analysis/service.py:474.
database/15_mcp_change_sets.sql:5 — mcp.model_change_set stores the draft; mcp.model_stage_batch at line 124 stores staged batch data. Inference completion does not apply the draft.
web_app/frontend/src/features/analysis/AnalysisScreen.tsx:267 — onCreated selects the new workflow_run_id and switches to run history.

web_app/frontend/src/features/workflows/WorkflowRunMonitor.tsx:110 — Reads run detail and paged events; refreshAll at line 234 refetches status. The backend reads are features/workflows/runs/router.py:58 and :79, then service.py:238 and :271.
web_app/frontend/src/features/workflows/WorkflowRunMonitor.tsx:539 — Displays validated draft state and the separate Apply action. This is where to confirm inference output before applying.
